name: Ring-bus feeder takeoff interface
summary: Identifies the circuit takeoff between its assigned adjacent ring breakers.
description: Identifies the circuit takeoff between its assigned adjacent ring breakers. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Adjacent ring switching nodes” at the input and “Feeder takeoff” at the output. Ring position changes its available supply paths.
